hypothesis: Prior-session 21-day concentration of SOXX absolute daily shocks amplifies future five-segment path drawdown when the account already has a larger received-close drawdown. The joint state/source risk is distinct from a static cushion cap or a shock main effect.
source_formula: shift one full session of rolling21 max(abs(SOXX daily log return))/sum(abs(SOXX daily log return))
state_feature: z[5]=decision-known received_actual_close_drawdown in frozen pi2 state model
label_target: saved pi2 same-anchor qualified segment drawdown risk for frozen 13 physical actions; value is checked only for action comparison
train: 2018-10-15 to 2019-12-31 role=fit, risk_known and value_known, label_available_at before 2020-01-01
test: 2020-01-01 to 2020-12-31 role=held, risk_known and value_known, label_available_at before 2021-01-01; no 2021+ data exist in this label panel
matched_controls: z0..z9 decision state, u0..u1 action, quoted fee fraction, shock concentration main effect; candidate adds shock*z5 interaction
model: weighted StandardScaler plus Ridge(alpha=100) with one control fit and one candidate fit; each source day total train weight one
source_gate: 2018/19/20 full prior-session shock source and >=200 risk-known 2020 held days, state/decision clock and label maturity, nonconstant interaction beyond main effect
information_gate: 2020 held-action dayweighted candidate risk MSE strictly below matched control and training-day constant, positive standardized interaction coefficient, 10-session block lower for control-minus-candidate loss>0
action_gate: Within each 2020 anchor, compare minimum predicted risk among the same three held physical actions; >=20 changed independent days, candidate minus control realized path-risk improvement block lower>0 and fee-net value damage upper bound<=0; unknown selected outcomes prohibit pass. This remains a local action screen, never a complete account.
stop: Close on first failed information or action gate; no sign, alpha, window, held-action choice or year rescue; no full candidate account
limits: risk label from pi2 fixed action path
not an OOF full strategy or SOXX account
